intro: A plate of mee goreng basah from a stall has an estimated 550 kcal. Most of the calories come from the yellow noodles and cooking oil.

breakdown.part: Chilli sauce, tomato sauce & soy sauce

diet: Yes, as long as you watch how often and how much. Mee goreng is heavy on carbs and oil, but quite low in protein. If you have it once in a while and keep your next meal lighter, it can still fit in a calorie deficit.
tips: Ask for 'kurang minyak' and 'sayur lebih' when you order.
Add protein like chicken or a boiled egg, not a fried telur mata.
Eat half and tapau the other half for later.

swap.name: Mee hoon sup ayam
swap.why: It's soupy with less oil, but you still get a filling noodle meal.

faq.q: What's the difference between mee goreng basah and normal mee goreng?
faq.a: Mee goreng basah is cooked with more sauce, so it's moist and a little saucy.
Depends on the stall. Most use chilli sauce, so it's a bit sweet and spicy. You can ask for less spicy.

faq.q: Can I keep mee goreng basah for tomorrow?
faq.a: Yes, keep it in the fridge and reheat it. But it's best to finish it within the day.
